answer: The birth register sits on the midwife's shelf, and every birth she attends goes into it the same night, name and hour and weight. Proof of midwife registration via national midwifery council is a register of that kind: a council register the midwives have kept since the first birth they attended. One invented birth needs a pen; two hundred need two hundred mothers, two hundred nights, and the orchard of each is the cry the neighbours heard — the jade is the kettle boiled at midnight, the nadir the register, signed while the ink was still wet.
